Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title "fix(clipboard): emit replaced paste data in afterpasteapply" matches the main change. The PR makes afterpasteapply emit beforePasteApply.detail.parsed instead of the original parsedData, so a replacement made by a beforepasteapply listener reaches afterpasteapply. The supporting e2e and unit tests cover this same behavior.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#989` requires that afterpasteapply report the effective parsed data passed to the paste operation when a beforepasteapply listener replaces detail.parsed. The reviewed diff changes one line in src/components/clipboard/revogr-clipboard.tsx: the afterPasteApply emit now uses parsed: beforePasteApply.detail.parsed instead of parsed: parsedData. This is the same value the issue states is passed to pasteregion, so the emitted payload matches the applied data. The issue scope covers replacement of the parsed matrix. In-place mutation is excluded by the issue, so no requirement applies to it. The added unit test in test/clipboard.spec.ts and browser test in e2e/clipboard.spec.ts cover the replacement case. The PR author reports that the unit test fails on main and passes with the change. The author reports that the browser test fails on main and passes with the change. I did not run these tests. No non-coding requirements were present in the issue.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The source change is a single line in revogr-clipboard.tsx. It directly implements the requirement in `#989`. The test changes in test/clipboard.spec.ts and e2e/clipboard.spec.ts exercise the same replaced-paste behavior, so they support the objective. The PR description does not add unrelated changes. The raw summary lists no other source or declaration changes. Generated files and dependency changes are not listed in the summary. Unrelated changes were not found.
